Spurs @ Bulls 4/10 7:00 - Wemby and Spurs should roll
Warriors @ Rockets 8/10 8:30 - Two 8-3 contenders, thin Warriors
Thunder @ Blazers 7/10 9:00 - SGA's short-handed Thunder, both back-to-back

games.notes: Butler, Porzingis and Moody out for Golden State; Adams and Capela out for Houston. Two 8-3 contenders, Curry carries a thin Warriors group, should be close.
Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace out for OKC; Morant and Sharpe out for Portland. Both on a back-to-back, SGA vs a surprising Blazers team, should be close.
Strawther out for Denver; Pippen Jr. and Post out for Memphis. Jokic against a 7-3 Grizzlies team, should be competitive though Denver is just mid.
Tobias Harris out and Vassell questionable; Powell, Collins and Caleb Wilson questionable for Chicago. Wemby and the Spurs vs a 1-8 team, likely blowout.
Paul George out for Boston, on a back-to-back; Kawhi and Barnes out for Toronto, Quickley questionable. Probably a Boston win.
Towns questionable and Hart out for the champion Knicks, on a back-to-back; Merrill and Tyson out for Cleveland. Knicks should win; Cavs are a mid team.
Grimes out for LA; Turner out and Herro questionable for Milwaukee. Luka and the Lakers vs a 1-10 team on a back-to-back, likely blowout.
Beekman, Champagnie and Vukcevic out for Washington; no Haliburton for Indiana. Two struggling teams, skip.
Mikel Brown Jr. out for Brooklyn, Traore questionable; Mathurin and Missi out, Murphy III doubtful for New Orleans. Two losing teams, skip.
Banchero, Suggs and Isaac out for Orlando; Markkanen, Jackson Jr. and Nurkic out for Utah. Both on back-to-backs, nothing to see.
